facts.text: The image is a vertical character reference sheet: a wide hero image at top, three full-body turnaround panels labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE and BACK in the middle, and four detail panels labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS and BOOTS at the bottom.

In the top hero panel, a person stands on a rain-soaked rooftop or elevated walkway at night, flanked by dark metal railings, with blurred city lights and illuminated building windows in the background.
The character wears a black high-collared tactical jacket over a dark crew-neck shirt, black cargo trousers and black lace-up combat boots.
In the FRONT panel, the character stands facing the camera with arms hanging at the sides, against a plain dark gray studio background.
In the SIDE PROFILE panel, the character faces viewer-left, with the jacket collar raised and hair gathered into a small topknot or bun at the back of the head.
In the BACK panel, the rear of the black jacket is visible, including shoulder seams and a horizontal back yoke, along with the trousers and boots.

The FACE close-up shows an adult man with short dark hair, shaved sides, a small topknot, East Asian facial features, a serious neutral expression, and a visible scar or notch above the eyebrow on the viewer-left side of the face.
The JACKET COLLAR detail shows black fabric, a zipper, and a strap with metal buckle or loop hardware on the jacket's shoulder and chest area.
The HANDS detail shows two relaxed hands side by side with visible knuckles and tendons.
The BOOTS detail shows black leather lace-up combat boots with visible laces, eyelets, seams and worn toe and sole areas.

card.summary: A character reference sheet for an adult man in black tactical clothing, featuring a rainy rooftop hero shot and studio turnaround and detail panels labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS and BOOTS.

card.style: Photorealistic cinematic character concept art and reference sheet with a low-key tactical urban aesthetic.
card.camera: Hero panel: wide eye-level full-body environmental shot. Studio panels: eye-level full-body front, side and back views plus close-up details.
card.characterisation: Stoic tactical urban character; the sheet emphasizes the facial scar, jacket hardware, hands and worn boots.

limitations: The image is a static composite; it cannot establish motion, camera movement, audio, music, dialogue or duration.
